stories.story_fr: Le 6 février 2026, AIG a finalisé l'acquisition d'une participation de 35% dans Convex Group Limited et d'une participation de 9,9% dans son actionnaire majoritaire Onex Corporation.
stories.story_en: On February 6, AIG completed the acquisition of a 35% equity interest in Convex Group Limited and a 9.9% ownership stake in its majority shareholder Onex Corporation.
stories.signal: On February 6, AIG completed the acquisition of a 35% equity interest in Convex Group Limited and a 9.9% ownership stake in its majority shareholder Onex Corporation

stories.story_fr: Le 27 octobre 2025, AIG a annoncé des accords définitifs pour acquérir les droits de renouvellement de la majorité des portefeuilles d'assurance commerciale retail d'Everest Group, représentant 2 milliards de dollars de primes agrégées.
stories.story_en: On October 27, AIG announced definitive agreements to acquire the renewal rights for a majority of Everest Group's global retail commercial insurance portfolios, representing $2 billion of aggregate premium.
stories.signal: AIG announced definitive agreements to acquire the renewal rights for a majority of Everest Group s global retail commercial insurance portfolios, representing $2 billion of aggregate premium

stories.story_fr: Le 30 avril 2026, le conseil d'administration d'AIG a déclaré un dividende en numéraire de 0,50 $ par action, en hausse de 11% par rapport aux dividendes trimestriels précédents, marquant la quatrième année consécutive de hausses de dividende d'au moins 10%.
stories.story_en: On April 30, AIG's Board of Directors declared a cash dividend of $0.50 per share, an 11% increase from prior quarterly dividends, marking the fourth consecutive year of 10%+ dividend increases.
stories.signal: AIG s Board of Directors declared a cash dividend of $0.50 per share on AIG common stock, an 11% increase from prior quarterly dividends, marking the fourth consecutive year of 10%+ dividend increases
